explanation: Used the eta (ep -> e'p eta) configuration since the request is an eta point. Physical eta production threshold is W = m_p + m_eta = 0.938272 + 0.54786 = 1.486132 GeV; the requested W = 1.52 GeV is above threshold and the input was generated, but the margin is only about 34 MeV, not 'comfortably above threshold' as characterized in the request -- this is a near-threshold point where the two-body phase space (eta CM momentum) is still small and rapidly opening, and Born/RC ratios can vary quickly with W there. cos(theta*) = -0.4 and phi* = 45 deg are ordinary physical angular values with no restriction. Kinematics fall inside the EtaMAID-2023 table grid (W: 1.4856-6 GeV, Q2: 0-5 GeV^2 in mpintp.inc), so exclurad.exe should run without extrapolation errors. Used model=3 (EtaMAID/maid2000), ivec=1 (recoil proton), full O(alpha) RC (rc_mode=0), default CLAS12 beam momentum 6.535 GeV (not specified by user) and default vcut=0.166 GeV^2 (CLAS12 inelasticity cut), matching the template eta/input.dat. Run with: ./build/exclurad.exe < eta_W1.520_Q2_0.600_cos-0.400_phi45.dat (requires building from eta/exclurad.F, eta/fint.F per eta/Makefile; no compiler is available in this environment so the run itself could not be executed here).
